```csharp
(OutSystems.Model.UI.Mobile.IMobileFlow common) => {
    
    /*** creating IMobileBlock 'Banner' ***/
    var banner = common.CreateBlock("Banner");
    banner.Description = null; // default value
    banner.Public = false; // default value
    var eSpace = common.GetESpace();
    
    var clicked = banner.CreateEvent("Clicked");
    clicked.IsMandatory = false;
    
    var onBannerClick = banner.CreateScreenAction("OnBannerClick");
    
    var startNode = onBannerClick.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IStartNode>();
    
    var showToast = onBannerClick.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IExecuteClientActionNode>("ShowToast");
    var showToast2 = eSpace.ClientActions.Named("ShowToast");
    showToast.Action = showToast2;
    startNode.Target = showToast;
    
    var endNode = onBannerClick.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IEndNode>();
    showToast.Target = endNode;
    
    var container = banner.CreateWidget<ServiceStudio.Plugin.NRWidgets.IContainer>();
    container.SetStyle("\"demo-banner\"");
    var event1 = container.CreateEvent();
    event1.Event = "onclick";
    event1.Handler = onBannerClick;
}
```
